tasks.subject: Task 1: Extract TransmitProcessor
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extract the per-capture denoise→vad→gate core from AudioVoiceEngine.nextOutgoingFrame into a shared TransmitProcessor, with a drift-guard test.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessorTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- process() returns gate Decision + denoises in place
- engine delegates; setVadThreshold works; subLevels removed
- drift-guard: engine vs standalone processor decide identically
- AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest still passes

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*TransmitProcessorTest" --tests "*AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt", "app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*TransmitProcessorTest\" --tests \"*AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["process returns Decision + denoises in place", "engine delegates; setVadThreshold works; subLevels removed", "drift-guard identical", "FrameNumberTest passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: VadEvaluationTest (end-to-end CI gate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run the corpus through real RNNoise + gate; assert per-category thresholds (full utterance passes); write report.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently, output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/VadEvaluationTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- clean_contiguous: coverage>=0.99 AND midDropoutMs==0
- speech_pause: midDropoutMs==0 (bridges 160ms pause)
- noise_only: falseOpenings<=1.0 per 10s
- app/build/reports/vad-eval/metrics.md written per clip

**Verify:** ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "*VadEvaluationTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/VadEvaluationTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*VadEvaluationTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["clean_contiguous coverage>=0.99 AND midDropoutMs==0", "speech_pause midDropoutMs==0", "noise_only falseOpenings<=1.0/10s", "metrics.md written per clip"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
